asset.name: useResizablePanel
asset.description: Pointer, keyboard and persistence behavior for one resizable panel: logical axis and edge, bounded clamping against the adjacent region, snap points, a collapse threshold, and an injectable storage adapter.

requires.reason: Pointer capture and cancellation keep movement outside React rendering.
The ceiling tracks the container without a layout read per pointer tick.
A logical edge only resolves to a physical one once the direction is known.

rationale: One behavior owner for every resizable region in the system. Keeping it a hook rather than a component is what lets a sidebar shell, a split pane and a terminal grid share the arithmetic while owning their own markup.
